items.title: Gadgets+
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
This world includes a modern laboratory and *30 SURVIVAL GADGETS*:

+ Lucky block and diamond generator!
+ Super advanced vehicles: car, submarine, mining drill, plane and hoverboard! 
+ Robot pets to help protect you!
+ Super sentry and mob repellants! 
+ Portal and jump pads!
+ Grappling hook and jet pack! 
+ Auto-base and auto-bone meal! 
+ And many more!

items.title: Pink vs Black Fashion
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
Are you a teen who enjoys showing off your cute pink kawaii looks or someone who likes to be in the shadows with your edgy gothic looks? With 10 skins that range in pink hues you can have it all from neon to pastel to 10 skins that range in black hues where you can be trendy and stylish!

- 20 modern skins

items.title: Adopt Teens
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Light up the city! Unleash your true colors and get ready to outshine for a skin pack all around pastel colors. Find your own pastel teen fashion, try different styles and match with your friends to create an explosion of rainbow pastel happiness!

- 10 vibrant role-playing pastel skins
- Perfect for multiplayer

items.title: One Block Challenge
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
You've spawned on a solitary block and need to survive!
Mine this ever-changing block to gather resources and build whatever your heart desires!


+ 2 game modes to choose from!
+ Play advanced mode where new islands spawn!
+ Random blocks and islands!
+ Endless randomized blocks!

items.title: Skyblock Greek Gods
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description: Skyblock with a Greek theme! Build your way from island to island, explore the world, and prepare for the final battle against the Ender Dragon!

items.title: Wizards Ninjas Robots
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
Just when you think you couldn't get a cooler skin.
This skin pack is a result of a wizard ninja robot mixed, yeah thats right!

x1 free skin

items.title: Mob Graduates
items.creator: The Rage Craft Room
items.description: Fellow students, way to go! The end of the school year! You made it! Time to show off that huge accomplishment in style with these 11 graduate mob skins who know how it feels. AMAZING! Just like you!

items.title: Neon Shadows Part 2
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
Five more fun designs in 3 different variants each in 5 colours.
Makes a lot of skins that could not fit in part 1.

Two free skins!

items.title: Freedom Gamer Teens
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
The best teen gamers have arrived in your city! Pick up your controller, join the most skillful players, and battle it out in skyblock or bedwars! Rock the world of gaming and be the number one on all the leaderboards!

- 1 free skin
- 20 skins
- By inPixel

items.title: Swamp Village
items.creator: Diluvian
items.description: Witches are known as the hostile mobs around our village. But don't worry, we created safe and cute houses for you to live in safe from the witches!

items.title: Crystalline Kingdom HD
items.creator: G2Crafted
items.description:
In this sequel to the Enchanted Folklore Forest skin pack, all mystical town folk, as well as the Crystalline people have been updated to HD. Also, some new skins have been created for extra role playing fun. Become a gnome, the Butterfly Prince or Princess, a talking tree and much more.

- 1 free skin included
- 14 skins

items.title: Royal Royalty
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Ever wanted to be royal? Well now's the time!

+ 8 HD prince / princess skins
+ Rich, beautiful clothing
+ Vibrant designs

items.title: Anime Agents
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: Calling all agents! Choose your favorite anime character to get the mission done. Go undercover with these unique skins!

items.title: Dragon Skies
items.creator: Noxcrew
items.description:
A once-whole kingdom has been torn apart; huge islands fill the sky, waiting for you to unearth their hidden secrets! Tame your new dragon companion and find your adventure in this mysterious realm.

+Upgrade your dragon with fire and flight
+Defeat epic bosses across the realm
+Dungeons, puzzles, loot and traps
+A fantasy adventure in survival mode

! Created by Noxcrew

items.title: Wizard Academia Pack 1
items.creator: G2Crafted
items.description:
While these wizard teens come together to enhance their magical skills, they certainly can't all look the same. With 70 mystical skins to choose from, this is one of the largest skin packs available. Now you can role play in your own personalized wizard in training skin.

- Includes 2 free skins
- This is pack 1 of 2
- Created by RedStudios, partnered with G2Crafted

items.title: Awesome Squad
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Jump into the action! Go pro with these 12 teen skins and create the most awesome squad in the city. Recruit as many members as possible and become the best! Choose any of these modern skins and create your next Minecraft adventure. Get the fame you crave!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 teen skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: City Friends 2077
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
The future is here and teens have arrived into the city and are ready to wear funky costumes while traveling into another dimension. Try parkouring and other city activities taking things to the next level. You and your friends can enjoy dystopian urban fashion while being the cool teens you know you are.

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 teen skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Anime Land
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Take a walk through unknown lands! Meet fancy teens with unique fashion senses. Embrace your inner anime spirit and join these teens in their new journey. Explore a new Minecraft world or binge-watch your favorite anime while hanging out with friends.

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 anime-themed skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: BED WARS
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
+ Bed wars minigame 
+ Multiplayer only
+ Classic bed wars map

Destroy your enemy and become a bed wars champion!

items.title: Mage City
items.creator: Blockception
items.description:
Be mesmerized by this giant magical city, filled with hundreds of chests to loot! With many different areas to explore, there are hours of fun to be had in this gorgeous survival spawn. Dive down into the dungeons and climb up the mage tower! Maybe you'll even see a dragon!

+ Colorful and detailed fantasy build!
+ Custom resource pack and models included!
+ Dragons!

items.title: Winter City Resort
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Live in a winter city resort! Ride snowboards, go skiing, or clean the streets of snow! Many winter adventures await you!

+ Helicopter & vehicles!
+ Winter furniture!
+ Snow vehicles!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: SypherPK MC Skinpack
items.creator: Logdotzip
items.description: 8 UNIQUE Skins from SypherPK! Play along in Minecraft as SypherPlays, the Oni or the Manic! Show off your style like Sypher does and be the best gamer possible. These exclusive skins are sure to help you take on the Wither or Ender Dragon with no problem!

items.title: Lucky Skyblock: Colors
items.creator: Norvale
items.description:
Lucky Skyblock: Colors

Embark on a fun, exciting, and colorful lucky skyblock experience! Seven unique and colorful floating islands, covered with lucky blocks for you and your friends to enjoy. 

+ Single and multiplayer friendly!
+ Varied and entertaining drops
By Norvale

items.title: Angels VS Devils
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
The light and dark sides of the universe are on the brink of war. Have you chosen which side you will fight on?

- 10 cool angel and devils skins!
+ 1 free skin!
- By Pixelusion & Lostduckies
